content.value_statement: Teams can miss plan flaws or code issues when workflow steps move quickly. This skill routes completed plans and implementations to review agents before the next phase.
actual_capabilities: Identifies plan completion signals and routes plans to plan-consultant review.
Identifies completed /implement coding work and routes changed files to code-reviewer.
Defines review focus areas for implementation plans and code changes.
Specifies a structured review report with status, findings, recommendations, and action items.
Requires blocked review results to stop workflow progression until revision.
limitations: It depends on plan-consultant and code-reviewer agents being available.
It describes workflow behavior but does not include executable automation code.
It does not run tests or perform the review itself.
The source example section is incomplete and should be finished by the author.

use_cases.title: Validate Implementation Plans
use_cases.description: Route completed planning work to a consultant agent before coding begins.

use_cases.title: Gate Code Before Commit
use_cases.description: Send completed implementation changes to a review agent before commit.

use_cases.title: Standardize Review Reports
use_cases.description: Use a consistent report format for findings, recommendations, and action items.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Plan Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a completed plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: The strategic-planner has completed this plan: [paste plan]. Use implementation-review to request a plan-consultant review.

prompt_templates.title: Review Completed Code
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for finished implementation work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Implementation is complete for [feature]. Use implementation-review to identify changed files and request code-reviewer feedback.

prompt_templates.title: Handle a Blocked Gate
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for a failed review gate.
prompt_templates.prompt: A review returned BLOCKED for [reason]. Use implementation-review constraints to list required revisions before the workflow continues.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an EPIC Handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for a full workflow transition.
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply implementation-review across this EPIC handoff: [plan], [changed files], [review status]. Produce the next gate decision and action items.

output_examples.input: A plan completion message arrives after strategy work for a feature.
output_examples.output: The skill routes the plan to plan-consultant, requests feasibility review, and reports any required revisions.

output_examples.input: Coding is finished in the /implement workflow with modified files ready.
output_examples.output: The skill routes changed files to code-reviewer and expects a status, findings, recommendations, and action items.

output_examples.input: A review returns BLOCKED because critical issues remain.
output_examples.output: The skill stops workflow progression and asks for revisions before the next phase or commit.

best_practices: Provide the complete plan or changed file list before requesting review.
Treat BLOCKED review status as a required revision step, not advice.
Keep review findings tied to clear action items and workflow decisions.
anti_patterns: Using trigger phrases before planning or implementation work is complete.
Treating the review handoff as a replacement for tests or security checks.
Continuing to the next workflow phase after a BLOCKED review status.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It routes completed plans and completed code work to specialized review agents.

faq.question: Does it run commands or tests?
faq.answer: No. The skill contains workflow instructions and does not include executable automation code.

faq.question: Which agents does it expect?
faq.answer: It expects plan-consultant for plan review and code-reviewer for code review.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it after planning completes or after implementation work is ready for review.

faq.question: What happens if review status is BLOCKED?
faq.answer: The workflow should stop until the required revisions are completed and reviewed again.

faq.question: Can it publish or commit code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It only defines review gates and expected reporting behavior.
